verdict.rationale: stagewise is documented as a desktop IDE whose agents work on local workspaces and run shell commands on the host. Nothing in the evidence describes configuring a reproducible cloud environment with repository dependencies or setup steps. Self-hosting the 'stagewise Cloud' is an enterprise deployment option, not a per-repo dev environment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
